field_principles.agent_visibility_results: Visibility rates show whether responses reached the agent text.
field_principles.configuration_strata: Strata prevent pooling across unlike games or configurations.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time exposes skipped or fabricated reducer execution.
field_principles.experiment_id: The identifier binds this artifact to REQ-ARC-6845.
field_principles.field_principles: Each top-level field states why an auditor needs it.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked verdict names the first failed check and observed value.
field_principles.headroom_results: Headroom shows whether rows could distinguish useful actions.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The complete_ prefix states the terminal evidence boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: This is deterministic CPU transcript audit work, not a live run.
field_principles.later_outcome_results: Outcome rates show whether exact later progress was available.
field_principles.next_action_results: Next-action rates show whether the agent acted after the response.
field_principles.obligation_ledger: The fresh ledger lists every reduced tool-gap obligation.
field_principles.per_game_results: One obligation row keeps the request, response, action, and outcome local.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: The gates show which evidence was required before eligibility.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: One digest binds the audit content except wall time.
field_principles.request_receipt_joins: Join counts show whether request and response identities exist.
field_principles.run_date: The date states when the frozen transcript audit ran.
field_principles.schema: The schema lets later reducers reject incompatible audit files.
field_principles.solve_claim: False prevents an audit artifact from becoming an ARC solve claim.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Source hashes bind the frozen artifacts used as inputs.
field_principles.status: The status separates effect-eligible audits from blocked audits.
field_principles.tool_gap_audit_complete_score: Completeness is about audit shape, not effect size.
field_principles.tool_gap_effect_eligible_score: Eligibility is 1 only when joins, timing, matching, outcomes, and headroom pass.
field_principles.transport_results: Transport metrics stop receipt success from becoming utility.
field_principles.unmatched_cell_results: Unmatched, loop-off, and no-obligation cells stay visible.
field_principles.utility_results: Utility metrics measure use, changed action, progress, and invalid actions.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed verdict class prevents unsupported positives.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because exact later outcomes are external receipts.
